# TRELLIS.2 multi-view model-sheet input

Load separate images for Camera 000° (front), 090° (left), 180° (rear), and 270° (right). Keep pose, scale, centerline, lighting, and canvas dimensions consistent.

Each view is background-cleaned independently, encoded independently by DINOv3, and combined as one ordered conditioning context. Do not use a flattened contact sheet here; keep that artifact for human review only.

All four cardinal camera branches pass through an independent CFP Input Mask Quality Gate. One blocked view stops reconstruction before the native engine starts. RMBG MASK sockets remain disconnected because the gates derive standard ComfyUI mask polarity from RGBA alpha.

Camera 270° is the right-side profile and is now a required populated lane in this four-view workbench.

After all four per-view mask gates pass, the CFP Model-Sheet Consistency Gate compares canvas size, normalized subject height, centerline, vertical center, baseline, and opposing-view width before TRELLIS starts.

The read-only Alignment Review branch renders an annotated 2x2 contact sheet directly from the four per-view mask-gate outputs. It does not resize, shift, replace, or promote any reconstruction input.

The Alignment Candidate branch creates transparent, uniformly scaled and translated copies using shared normalized image-space targets. The 250 mm design height is metadata only. Candidate outputs feed an AFTER review sheet but remain disconnected from TRELLIS until a human explicitly promotes them.
